purpose: Tracks the SHA-256 digest of every applied Knowledgebase migration in apps/knowledge/migrations/. Adoption is keyed on filename only (apps/knowledge/app/database.py records knowledge.schema_migrations.version = filename), so editing an already-applied .sql in place is a silent no-op on every database that adopted it; tests/m12-t2.2-a4-migration-digest.test.mjs reddens when a listed file's bytes change, and the correct action is to add a NEW forward migration, never to edit a listed one. A file NOT listed here is treated as a forward migration and stays green, which is deliberate: when a new migration is released and begins being adopted, append it with its digest, because from that moment editing it in place becomes the same silent no-op.
